_readme: Title/slug overrides for /ask/ pages generated by scripts/sync-ask.mjs.
Askers title their own threads and some are too terse to work as a page title
or a URL ('AZ-400', 'SC-900'). Set a clearer one here, keyed by discussion number.
Titles must describe what was actually asked — never invent a question.
Omit 'slug' to derive it from the overridden title.
Set 'exclude' with a reason to keep a thread off /ask/ entirely — it stays
visible on /feedback/, it just doesn't become a permanently-indexed page.
_excluded: Answered and substantial, but wrong to index forever.

9.exclude: Billing/access dispute resolved privately by email. Indexing 'I did not get access to the certs that I paid for' would make a permanent negative search result against a paid product, and it names the customer.

13.exclude: Private request for paid 1:1 mentoring, includes the asker's city and LinkedIn approach. Correspondence, not a public answer.

14.exclude: A thank-you note, not a question. Nothing for a reader to learn.

24.exclude: A rant about a Microsoft product ('did not sign up for it & it sucks') rather than a question. Serves no reader and reads badly under Sush's byline.
